nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner stored in Owned; written in Owned constructor and acceptOwnership, read by onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address stored in Owned; written by transferOwnership and cleared by acceptOwnership.
Mapping(address => uint) of token balances held by COCCO; read and written by transfer, transferFrom, balanceOf, totalSupply and the constructor.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of spender allowances; written by approve and approveAndCall, decremented by transferFrom, read by allowance.
Total token supply of COCCO set in constructor to 1000000000000 and read by totalSupply.
Public token symbol string, set to 'COCCO' in the constructor.
Public token name string, set to 'COCCO' in the constructor.
Public token decimals value, set to 5 in the constructor.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure function adding two values and requiring c >= a; called by transfer and transferFrom.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure function requiring b <= a before subtracting; called by transfer and transferFrom.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure function checking multiplication overflow.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure function requiring b > 0.
Owned constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) guarded by onlyOwner; stores the pending owner in newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership() requiring msg.sender == newOwner, moves newOwner into owner and clears newOwner.
COCCO constructor that sets symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and mints the whole supply to 0x0c859633811986f7bD06244352131F6139E7aB87.
COCCO.totalSupply() constant returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
COCCO.balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant returns balances[tokenOwner].
COCCO.transfer(address to, uint tokens) debits balances[msg.sender] via safeSub and credits balances[to] via safeAdd, emitting Transfer.
COCCO.approve(address spender, uint tokens) writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
COCCO.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) debits balances[from], decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] and credits balances[to].
COCCO.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
COCCO.approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) sets allowance and then calls ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval, an external callback.
Payable fallback function of COCCO that unconditionally reverts, rejecting ETH.
COCCO.transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner function performing an external ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) call.
External caller address (msg.sender) used for ownership assignment, onlyOwner checks and balance/allowance accounting.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an attacker-controlled token address inside transferAnyERC20Token.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) executed after state changes in approveAndCall.
Arithmetic operation allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens) performed in transferFrom.
Parameter a of SafeMath.safeAdd.
Parameter b of SafeMath.safeAdd.
Parameter _newOwner of Owned.transferOwnership.
Parameter to of COCCO.transfer, the recipient address.
Parameter tokens of COCCO.transfer, the amount transferred.
Parameter spender of COCCO.approve, the approved address.
Parameter from of COCCO.transferFrom, the debited account.
Parameter tokenAddress of COCCO.transferAnyERC20Token, the external token contract address.
Local/return variable c holding the result of SafeMath.safeAdd.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, so attacker-controlled caller input initializes ownership state.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to transfer ownership.
transfer reads and debits balances[msg.sender] with the caller-supplied tokens amount.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using caller identity.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender], binding the caller identity to allowance accounting.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender into the external receiveApproval callback.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
Owned constructor writes the owner state variable from msg.sender.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
COCCO constructor sets the symbol state variable.
COCCO constructor sets the name state variable.
COCCO constructor sets the decimals state variable.
COCCO constructor sets the _totalSupply state variable.
COCCO constructor credits balances[0x0c85...] with the entire supply.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer writes balances[msg.sender] and balances[to].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom writes balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom writes allowed[from][msg.sender] allowance.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external callback.
transfer calls SafeMath.safeSub on the sender balance.
transfer calls SafeMath.safeAdd on the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.safeSub for balances[from] and the allowance.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.safeAdd for balances[to].
transferFrom performs the allowance subtraction allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(...), an arithmetic state update reachable with caller-controlled tokens.
approveAndCall performs an external callback into ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval after updating allowances, allowing the callee to re-enter the token.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary tokenAddress contract, giving owner-controlled external code execution with the caller-supplied address.
transferAnyERC20Token uses the owner state variable as the transfer recipient and as the onlyOwner gate.
Parameter a flows into SafeMath.safeAdd.
Parameter b flows into SafeMath.safeAdd.
Parameter _newOwner flows into the newOwner state variable in transferOwnership.
Parameter to is used as the credit key in transfer.
Parameter tokens is the debited/credited amount in transfer.
Parameter spender is used as the allowance key in approve.
Parameter from is the debited account and allowance owner in transferFrom.
Parameter tokenAddress is the target of the external call in transferAnyERC20Token.
Local result variable c is assigned and returned by SafeMath.safeAdd.
